content.text: The last pilgrimage took place in the solemn, warm, and meaningful atmosphere, bringing calm, peaceful moments to each attendee.

The church's love for the parish is the motivation for TodayTourist to always serve more devotedly and with more than a day.
Your Grace, Your Honours, Your Honours, and the community are always well, many blessings and peace.
See you on the next pilgrimages.
